greet.speaker: Frozen Explorer
greet.text: A traveler sits slumped against the ice wall, rime crusted over an old coat. Their eyes flicker open as you approach.
greet.text_zh: 一名旅人靠著冰牆癱坐著，破舊的外套上結滿了霜。你靠近時，他們的眼睛微微睜開。

talk.speaker: Frozen Explorer
talk.text: Don't waste breath on me... I came for the treasure the old golem guards. Got greedy. Got slow. The ice doesn't forgive slow.
talk.text_zh: 別浪費力氣在我身上……我是為了那尊老巨像守著的寶藏來的。太貪心，太遲鈍。冰不會放過遲鈍的人。

choices.text: Is there a way to save you?
Any advice for the ice ahead?
choices.text_zh: 對前面的冰有什麼建議嗎？

treasure.speaker: Frozen Explorer
treasure.text: Something forged in the golem's own frost-heart, they say. Deeper in, past where the ice doesn't let you stop. You'll know the golem when the whole cavern goes quiet.
treasure.text_zh: 聽說是用巨像自己的冰霜之心鍛造出來的東西。在更深處，過了那片不讓你停下的冰地之後。當整個洞穴安靜下來時，你就會知道巨像到了。

no_saving.speaker: Frozen Explorer
no_saving.text: Ha. Kind of you to ask. No — I made my choices long before I sat down here. Go on. Don't let my slowness be for nothing.
no_saving.text_zh: 哈，你能問這句就很好心了。不——我早在坐下之前就做好了選擇。去吧，別讓我的遲鈍白白浪費。

advice.speaker: Frozen Explorer
advice.text: The ice doesn't care what you meant to do, only what you're doing. Keep a direction in mind before you step on, and don't panic when your feet won't listen.
advice.text_zh: 冰不管你原本想做什麼，只管你正在做什麼。踏上去之前先想好方向，腳不聽使喚時也別慌。
